primitives.name: Preventive Build Inventory
primitives.verbatim_quote: # Final Critic Review As of: 2026-06-09 | Question | Answer | | --- | --- | | Did we inventory existing builds first?
primitives.assumptions: All builds are indexed prior to new generation; no prior knowledge of duplicates exists.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When N_{\text{builds}} < 100, risk of collision increases exponentially.

layer2.mapping: Categorical inclusion functor from prior build set to new build generation space.

primitives.name: Extension Integrity Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: | No direct duplicate cards were intentionally created; related work is marked EXTENSION, VARIANT, or DEPENDENCY.
primitives.assumptions: Each extension is tagged with explicit dependency metadata.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When D_{\text{dup}} = 1, extension is invalid under policy.

layer2.mapping: Kernel of dependency tagging function maps E_{\text{ext}} to {EXTENSION, VARIANT, DEPENDENCY}.

primitives.name: Task Splitting Boundary Condition
primitives.verbatim_quote: | The queue avoids splitting one simple task except where compliance/data/copy/finance are distinct approval boundaries.
primitives.assumptions: Tasks are only split when B_{\text{boundary}} is non-trivial.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When T_{\text{task}} is split without B_{\text{boundary}}, task coherence degrades.

layer2.mapping: Partition function on task space restricted to boundary types.
layer2.telemetry: Task coherence score per boundary type.
